entries.title: The words will outlast the moment
entries.literal_meaning: The words will remain for all time.
entries.explanation: A conversation ends, but what was said can remain in memory. The dictionary labels this short line a Dhaga under “for ever”. It can give a promise weight or warn that a remark will not be easily forgotten. Which feeling it carries depends on the speaker and the occasion; the source does not specify a single original scene.
entries.meaning_odia: କଥା କହିବାର ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତଟି ସରିଯାଏ, ହେଲେ କହିଥିବା କଥା ମନରେ ରହିଯାଇପାରେ। ଛୋଟ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଗୋଟିଏ ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତିକୁ ଓଜନ ଦେଇପାରେ, ପୁଣି ଭୁଲି ନ ହେବା ଭଳି କଥା ପ୍ରତି ସତର୍କ କରିପାରେ। କିଏ କାହାକୁ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରରେ କହୁଛି, ସେଥିରୁ ଏହାର ଭାବ ବଦଳେ।
entries.english_summary: A conversation ends, but what was said can remain in memory.
entries.odia_summary: କଥା କହିବାର ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତଟି ସରିଯାଏ, ହେଲେ କହିଥିବା କଥା ମନରେ ରହିଯାଇପାରେ।
entries.usage_example: Two friends recall a promise made years earlier; one says that the words have stayed with them. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: Possible uses are editorial readings, not recorded testimony. Source spelling ରହିୟିବ is retained; no guarantee that every utterance survives.

entries.title: When both of us agree
entries.odia: ତୋର ମୋର ରାଜି, କିସ କରିବ କାଜି
entries.literal_meaning: You and I agree—what can the qazi do?
entries.explanation: The rhyme between raji and qazi turns agreement into a cheeky challenge to an outside authority. The dictionary places it under the qazi’s marriage-registration role. Its force is rhetorical: if the people concerned agree, why should someone else obstruct them? That is the speaker’s claim, not a statement that consent removes legal duties.
entries.meaning_odia: ତୁ ରାଜି, ମୁଁ ରାଜି—ତେବେ ମଝିରେ ଆଉ କାହାର ବାଧା କାହିଁକି? ରାଜି ଓ କାଜିର ମିଳ ଏହି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନକୁ ଟିକେ ମଜା ଓ ଟିକେ ଆହ୍ୱାନର ସ୍ୱର ଦିଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ କାଜିଙ୍କ ବିବାହ ପଞ୍ଜୀକରଣ ଭୂମିକା ପାଖରେ ଏହି ଉଦାହରଣ ଅଛି। ଏହା କହୁଥିବା ଲୋକର ଯୁକ୍ତି; ଆଇନର ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: The rhyme between raji and qazi turns agreement into a cheeky challenge to an outside authority.
entries.odia_summary: ତୁ ରାଜି, ମୁଁ ରାଜି—ତେବେ ମଝିରେ ଆଉ କାହାର ବାଧା କାହିଁକି? ରାଜି ଓ କାଜିର ମିଳ ଏହି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନକୁ ଟିକେ ମଜା ଓ ଟିକେ ଆହ୍ୱାନର ସ୍ୱର ଦିଏ।
entries.usage_example: Two collaborators agree on a meeting time while an uninvolved acquaintance keeps objecting; one jokingly uses the saying. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: Preserve the named role without religious caricature. Surrounding dictionary institutional claims are not adopted as present law or independently verified history.
